description: This file contains unit tests for a worker pool implementation, including job scheduling, rescheduling, cancellation, and metadata validation, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: EventControl
classes.description: A helper class to manage event signaling for synchronization in tests.

classes.name: TestJob
classes.description: A template class representing a job that can be dispatched, with status tracking and optional parent interaction.

classes.name: JobData
classes.description: A structure to hold data related to a scheduled job, including event control, timing, and scheduling info.

classes.name: JobControl
classes.description: A class managing job scheduling, external worker threads, and validation within the worker pool.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTester
classes.description: A subclass of the worker pool used for testing, with additional methods for job submission, external thread management, and metadata validation.

classes.name: WorkerJobTester
classes.description: A class representing a test job with scheduling, rescheduling, revoking, and dispatch logic, used for testing job handling.

classes.name: Trigger
classes.description: A class that schedules repeated jobs at intervals, with logic to handle timed execution and overrun detection.

methods.name: CheckScheduledTime
methods.description: Validates that the invoked time matches the scheduled time, considering seconds and expected delay.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_ReschduledTimedJob
methods.description: Tests the behavior of timed job scheduling and overrun handling in the worker pool.

methods.name: CheckMetaData
methods.description: Validates the current state of the worker pool's metadata, including pending jobs, occupation, and total runs.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_MetaData
methods.description: Runs a test to verify worker pool metadata before and after job execution.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_Ids
methods.description: Verifies that thread IDs are correctly assigned and identifiable within the worker pool.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_MultipleJobs
methods.description: Tests handling multiple jobs with different scheduling and cancellation scenarios.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_CancelJobs_InBetween
methods.description: Tests canceling jobs during execution and verifies correct timeout and status.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_ScheduleJobs
methods.description: Schedules jobs with specific delays and verifies their execution and cancellation.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_RescheduleJobs
methods.description: Reschedules jobs and verifies correct timing and status after rescheduling.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_ReschduledTimedJob
methods.description: Tests scheduled timed jobs and their execution over multiple cycles.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Submit
methods.description: Tests submitting a job to the worker pool and waiting for completion.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Submit_Revoke
methods.description: Tests submitting and revoking a job before processing.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Schedule
methods.description: Tests scheduling a job for future execution.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Schedule_Revoke
methods.description: Tests scheduling and revoking a scheduled job.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Reschedule
methods.description: Tests rescheduling a job and verifying execution.

methods.name: CheckJobType_Reschedule_Revoke
methods.description: Tests rescheduling a job and then revoking it.

methods.name: CheckJobType_RescheduleJobs
methods.description: Tests rescheduling multiple jobs and verifying their execution and cancellation.

methods.name: CheckWorkerPool_RescheduleJobs
methods.description: Reschedules jobs multiple times and verifies correct timing and status.
